title: Dinosaur wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Party hat -->
  <polygon points='50,8 42,32 58,32' fill='#FF4FA3'/>
  <polygon points='50,8 46,20 54,20' fill='#FFD93D'/>
  <polygon points='50,8 48,14 52,14' fill='#7CFF6B'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='8' r='4' fill='#FFD93D'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='8' r='2' fill='#FF4FA3'/>
  <!-- Hat brim / band -->
  <rect x='41' y='30' width='18' height='4' rx='2' fill='#7CFF6B'/>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='24' ry='22' fill='#4CD964'/>
  <!-- Belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='16' ry='14' fill='#B8FF7A'/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d='M28,78 Q14,74 12,62 Q18,68 26,64 Z' fill='#3BBF4E'/>
  <!-- Left leg -->
  <rect x='36' y='86' width='10' height='10' rx='4' fill='#3BBF4E'/>
  <!-- Right leg -->
  <rect x='54' y='86' width='10' height='10' rx='4' fill='#3BBF4E'/>
  <!-- Left arm -->
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='68' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#3BBF4E' transform='rotate(-20 27 68)'/>
  <!-- Right arm -->
  <ellipse cx='73' cy='68' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#3BBF4E' transform='rotate(20 73 68)'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='19' ry='17' fill='#4CD964'/>
  <!-- Snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='12' ry='8' fill='#B8FF7A'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='46' r='4' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='46' r='4' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='46' r='2.2' fill='#1B2B3A'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='46' r='2.2' fill='#1B2B3A'/>
  <circle cx='44.7' cy='45.2' r='0.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='56.7' cy='45.2' r='0.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Nostrils -->
  <circle cx='47' cy='54' r='1.3' fill='#3BBF4E'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='54' r='1.3' fill='#3BBF4E'/>
  <!-- Mouth / smile -->
  <path d='M44,59 Q50,63 56,59' stroke='#3BBF4E' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Spikes on back -->
  <polygon points='43,32 46,22 49,32' fill='#FFD93D'/>
  <polygon points='49,32 52,21 55,32' fill='#FFD93D'/>
  <polygon points='55,32 58,23 61,32' fill='#FFD93D'/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='53' r='3' fill='#FF8FB1' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='53' r='3' fill='#FF8FB1' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
